evals.prompt: The verification skill in {fixtures}/drifted-app was written in March and things have shipped since. I think its feature map is lying about what it covers. Audit it against the source in {fixtures}/drifted-app/src.
evals.expected_output: An audit that finds three drifts against the source: the Export CSV row covers a feature that was deleted, bulk void shipped and is absent from the map, and the send-invoice proof names a test id the component no longer has, plus the claim that the map is complete being false.
expectations: Finds that the Export CSV row covers a feature that no longer exists, since there is no export route in router.js
Finds that bulk void shipped at /invoices/bulk-void and is missing from the feature map
Finds that the Send invoice proof names [data-testid="send-invoice"] while InvoiceDetail.jsx renders data-testid="invoice-send", so that step cannot pass as written
Flags the 'Not covered: Nothing. The map above is complete.' claim as false, given the bulk void gap
Grounds each finding in the source rather than in the changelog alone, so the audit does not depend on the changelog being accurate
Treats the existing skill as the subject of an audit and proposes corrections to it, rather than authoring a replacement verification skill
Does not report a finding it cannot point at a file for

evals.prompt: You audited {fixtures}/drifted-app and found the feature map is out of date. Before I take a PR of corrections: how do you know each correction is right, and what would you have to run to be sure?
evals.expected_output: A separation of the corrections that are proven by reading the source from the ones that need the app driven to confirm, with the send-invoice test id treated as readable from the component and the new bulk void proof treated as unproven until it has actually been driven.
expectations: Separates corrections established by reading the source from corrections that require running the application to confirm
Treats a newly written proof for bulk void as unproven until it has been driven against the running app, rather than as correct because it was derived from the component
Names what it would run, and gates on an observable result rather than on the script exiting zero
States that the removal of the Export CSV row is safe to make from the source alone, since the route is absent
Does not propose shipping every correction in one unverified batch
Does not treat the changelog as sufficient proof that a feature was removed

evals.prompt: Audit the verification skill in {fixtures}/accurate-app against {fixtures}/accurate-app/src. Is its feature map still honest?
evals.expected_output: A verdict that the map is accurate: both documented features match the routes and the test ids in the components, and the one uncovered feature is already disclosed, so there is nothing to correct.
expectations: Concludes the feature map is accurate and needs no corrections, without manufacturing a finding
Confirms at least one test id against the component that renders it, such as hours-submit in TimesheetEntry.jsx or week-approve in ApprovalQueue.jsx
Recognizes the payroll export as already disclosed under 'Not covered', rather than reporting it as a coverage gap the skill hides
Does not recommend adding coverage for the payroll export as a correction, since the prompt asks whether the map is honest
Does not open a PR or propose edits when it has found nothing to correct
